candidates.description: This vector activates strongly for the Devanagari character 'भ' (bha) and its various vowel and conjunct modifications.
This feature vector represents common Hindi punctuation marks and vowel-sign combinations that terminate sentences.
This vector is related to common prefixes and initial syllables in Hindi script and numerals.
This vector activates on various forms and conjuncts of the Devanagari consonant 'pa' (प) across different contexts.
This vector activates for Hindi consonants combined with vowel signs (matras).
This vector activates on common subwords and characters frequently occurring across Hindi and English text tokens.
This vector represents Hindi dependent vowel signs (matras) and consonant-vowel combinations.
This vector represents Devanagari script characters and vowel signs used in Indian languages.
This feature vector represents the Devanagari vowel sign "ā" combined with various consonant characters.
The tokens represent common character sequences and morphemes from Hindi text.
